steps.title: Install the wallet app
steps.instructions: Install from the official website or trusted app store. Open the app and reach the create/import screen.
steps.expectedResult: The wallet application is installed and launches successfully on your device.

steps.title: Create the wallet & secure the seed
steps.instructions: Create a new wallet. Write the recovery phrase on paper (or another offline method). Confirm the phrase in the app if prompted.
steps.expectedResult: Wallet created; seed phrase stored securely offline — not in screenshots, email, or cloud notes.

steps.title: Receive address ready
steps.instructions: Open Receive / Deposit and copy your public address. Optionally verify the address format looks correct for the network.
steps.expectedResult: You can display and copy your public receive address without exposing the seed phrase.

steps.title: Fund with a test amount (optional)
steps.instructions: Send a small amount of crypto to your new address from an exchange or another wallet. Wait for confirmation.
steps.expectedResult: Balance shows the incoming funds (or pending confirmation). Keep a screenshot of the balance or tx as your proof.
